mina: Quick idea for next week's webinar: test two activation nudges tied to attendance. Flow A: 60 starter credits + 2 prompt templates delivered on first successful API call. Flow B: no upfront credits but guaranteed 30-min office hours slot + guided quickstart. Goal: compare 7d activation and 14d retention. budget cap $2k.

leo: sounds good. routing ask: randomize at signup, persist, and only grant credits on first_success to avoid farming. can growth-bot handle email-domain filtering? @growth-bot

growth-bot: experiment created: id sparkline-2026-05. assignment: randomized at signup, saved to user.experiments.sparkline. grant triggers on first_success for credits arm. whitelist regex: corporate emails only. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/sparkline-2026-05

tara: analytics: capture experiment_id, arm, webinar_attended boolean, first_success_ts, and initial_token_usage. i'll run a funnel report and post results next Tue.

evan: creative + copy: i'll draft two email sequences (claim credits vs claim office hours) and 3 social blurbs. ETA Wed morning.

mina: ops payload for credits arm: ```json
{"experiment_id":"sparkline-2026-05","arm":"credits","credits":60,"cap_per_user":60}
```

leo: i'll implement routing and add budget alert when spend > $400 in 24h. also expire credits after 10 days.

tara: assign owners: @tara analytics, @leo infra, @evan creative. launch Monday if infra + creative green. keep updates here.
